data.headline: Asbury Park agenda cites Waterfront Redevelopment Plan ordinance

claims.text: The City of Asbury Park agenda lists an ordinance concerning the City’s Waterfront Redevelopment Plan.

citation.quote: 2026-26 Ordinance Of The City Of Asbury Park, In The County Of Monmouth, State Of New Jersey, Readopting Ordinance 2953 And Vacating A Portion Of St. James Place Pursuant To N.J.S.A. 40:67-1, Et Seq. And The City’s Waterfront Redevelopment Plan

claims.text: STHO is the managing member in Asbury Partners, LLC, the joint venture that owns the Asbury Park Waterfront investment.

citation.quote: We are the managing member in Asbury Partners, LLC, which is the joint venture that owns the Asbury Park Waterfront investment.

claims.text: STHO reported an aggregate carrying value of approximately $120.9 million for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment as of June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: The aggregate carrying value of the Asbury Park Waterfront investment was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

claims.text: STHO's current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to manage operating assets and monetize remaining development sites through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting redevelopment-agreement obligations.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.
